title: Product page sends a failing view-count update; views include the owner's own visits
steps: Sign in as the seller and open their product: PUT /api/products/:id {"view_count":N} -> 400 "No updatable product fields provided" (other users would get 403).
GET /api/products/:id already increments view_count for every request, including the owner and refreshes.
expected: One server-side view count per visit that excludes the owner (and ideally repeat refreshes).
actual: A dead client-side PUT on every product visit (console error) and an inflated "Product views" figure on Business Analytics.
impact: Misleading analytics for sellers; wasted request and console error for every visitor.
fix: Remove the client PUT; in GET skip the increment when the viewer is the owner (optionally de-duplicate per visitor per hour in Redis).
